messages:
Maya: Heads-up — EU onboarding tenants (eu-west1) are seeing auth + token refresh latency spikes since ~09:05 UTC, intermittent 401s. Impacting ~120 active trial accounts. We need a crisp customer comms plan + credit proposal.

Ashley: Can you share affected list? Also need guidance on credit tiers for trials vs paying accounts.

Raj: Pulling affected list now, correlating with deploys. Early signal aligns with a config rollout at ~09:00. Will upload CSV shortly.

Kevin: Confirmed rollback of the token-refresh config at 09:17 reduced errors ~80%. Suspect rate-limiter burst window mis-config on auth-proxy. Full RCA in progress.

Maya: Action items (quick):
1) CS outreach template (short update + next steps)
2) Exec note for +$50k ARR accounts
3) Credit proposal + trial extensions
4) Schedule enablement office hours for onboarding help
I can draft the generic template if someone reviews.

Ashley: Proposed credits: `high_risk_paid`: min($500, 5% monthly committed spend); `trial_tier`: trial extension 14 days + $200 credit. Open to adjustments.

Laura: +1 to extension + credit. Also recommend offering a 30min onboarding call for the top 20 impacted accounts. I'll coordinate availability.

Tim: Flag any accounts >$50k ARR as high priority — I'll join outreach and add AE note. Need the list ASAP.

Maya: Raj — please upload CSV to shared drive and add `risk_level` column (high/medium/low). We'll prioritize outreach.

Raj: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood/incident/3467891234/affected_accounts.csv — columns: org, contact_email, start_time, error_count, risk_score.

Ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1845 created — Severity: P2. Details: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1845

Kevin: Draft RCA summary: 'Config drift in auth-proxy rate-limiter rules after canary introduced an overly permissive burst window for refresh token endpoints -> token refresh 429s -> downstream 401s during onboarding flows. Rolled back change and tightened canary gating. Next steps: add config unit tests, integrate canary validation scripts, and add faster alerting for token-refresh error spike.'

Maya: Draft outreach (short):
"We experienced intermittent auth errors affecting onboarding flows in eu-west1 between 09:00–09:20 UTC. We rolled back the change and fixed the issue. We're sorry for the disruption. We're offering a one-time credit and a free onboarding session to impacted customers. If you still see issues, contact support at support@redwood.ai or reply here."

Ashley: Suggest we append impacted region + direct status link and a clear CTA for customers who still see failures. Also include how we computed credits.

Laura: I'll localize the message for FR/DE customers and prepare a two-step cadence: email now -> follow-up call within 48h if no reply.

Tim: For flagged high-risk accounts, AEs should send a personalized note and loop in me if they want exec support.

Maya: Tracking sheet (please update owner column): https://sheets.redwood/incident-3467891234 — add AE owner, outreach status, and credit amount.

Raj: Updated CSV with `ae_owner` and `risk_level`. Set `last_updated` = 09:30 UTC.

Ashley: I'll produce templates: `email_v1`, `slack_v1`, and `ae_copy`. Putting them in the shared folder with variables for credit amount and AE name.

Kevin: RCA doc draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/eng/rca-3467891234.md — will add postmortem details and mitigation timelines. ETA EOD.

Maya: Customer comms schedule:
- T+1h: short broadcast email to all affected (CS)
- T+6h: personalized outreach for high-risk accounts (AE + CS)
- T+48h: optional office hours for onboarding help
- Final: full RCA and any compensation details once RCA complete

Laura: Office hours draft: Mon 14:00 UTC — registration link created. I'll post to tracker.

Tim: Can the AE team get a templated Slack DM so it's quick to ping accounts?

Ashley: Yes, will add Slack DM template to folder and label clearly.

Maya: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your assigned item. I'll send the first broadcast after the checks.

Tim: ✅ I've flagged +$50k accounts and notified AEs.

Laura: ✅ Localized drafts in folder (FR/DE).

Kevin: ✅ RCA draft uploaded.

Raj: ✅ CSV updated with AE assignments and risk scores.

Maya: Final note — please capture any customer feedback in the `feedback` tab of the tracker. We'll monitor for renewal risk flags and schedule 1:1 follow-ups where needed.

Ashley: I'll collate feedback into a summary doc and surface top themes daily.

Maya: Thanks everyone — good coordination. I'll post a short external note in 45m once templates are approved.
